title: 共軛焦顯微鏡
summary: 從點照明與點偵測的共軛關係推導針孔為何能排除離焦光，用艾里單位把針孔直徑、橫向解析度與光學切片厚度連起來，再把螢光光子預算、振鏡掃描時序、偵測器死時間、折射率失配與奈奎斯特取樣整合成一台可驗收的雷射掃描共軛焦顯微鏡。
summaryEn: Derive from the conjugate relation of point illumination and point detection why a pinhole rejects out-of-focus light, use Airy units to tie pinhole diameter to lateral resolution and optical-section thickness, then integrate the fluorescence photon budget, galvanometer timing, detector dead time, refractive-index mismatch and Nyquist sampling into an acceptable laser-scanning confocal microscope.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 取樣與針孔練習：63×/1.4 油鏡、λ_exc = 488 nm、λ_em = 520 nm、n = 1.518。1 AU = 1.22×0.52/1.4 = 0.453 µm，在 63× 中間像面為 28.6 µm 的針孔直徑。橫向半高寬 0.51×0.488/1.4 ≈ 0.178 µm，1 AU 軸向半高寬 ≈ √(0.491² + 0.695²) ≈ 0.85 µm；奈奎斯特像素 ≤ 0.089 µm、z 步進 ≤ 0.43 µm，1024 像素對應 92 µm 視場，20 µm 厚的細胞需 47 層。艾里斑第一暗環內含 84% 的能量、第二暗環內含 91%，所以針孔從 1 AU 開到 2 AU 只多收 8% 的焦內訊號，卻把軸向半高寬從 0.85 µm 拉到 1.47 µm，並讓離焦光通過面積增為 4 倍；縮到 0.5 AU 時只剩約 59% 的焦內能量，訊號損失 30% 而解析度僅小幅改善。因此 1 AU 是訊號與切片的常用折衷。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Sampling and pinhole exercise: 63×/1.4 oil objective, λ_exc = 488 nm, λ_em = 520 nm, n = 1.518. 1 AU = 1.22×0.52/1.4 = 0.453 µm, which is a 28.6 µm pinhole at the 63× intermediate image. Lateral FWHM 0.51×0.488/1.4 ≈ 0.178 µm and axial FWHM at 1 AU ≈ √(0.491² + 0.695²) ≈ 0.85 µm; Nyquist pixel ≤ 0.089 µm and z-step ≤ 0.43 µm, so 1024 pixels span a 92 µm field and a 20 µm thick cell needs 47 slices. The first dark ring of the Airy pattern encloses 84% of the energy and the second 91%, so opening the pinhole from 1 to 2 AU gains only 8% in-focus signal while stretching the axial FWHM from 0.85 to 1.47 µm and quadrupling the area open to out-of-focus light; closing to 0.5 AU keeps only about 59% of the in-focus energy, a 30% signal loss for a small resolution gain. Hence 1 AU is the usual compromise between signal and sectioning. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「點照明、點偵測與光學切片」與「螢光物理與單像素光子預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 點照明、點偵測與光學切片：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Point illumination, point detection and optical sectioning: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「共軛焦針孔與艾里斑」如何決定共軛焦顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Confocal pinhole and Airy disc” determines the key performance of “Confocal microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 共軛焦顯微鏡把雷射聚成一個繞射極限光點照明樣品，並在偵測路徑上與焦點共軛的位置放一個針孔；焦平面上的螢光成像在針孔中心通過，離焦平面的螢光在針孔處散成大斑而大部分被擋掉。系統點擴散函數是照明與偵測點擴散函數的乘積，因此橫向解析度略優於寬場，而沿光軸的訊號隨離焦距離快速衰減，形成光學切片。針孔直徑以艾里單位（AU）表示，1 AU 等於艾里斑第一暗環的直徑。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「共軛焦針孔與艾里斑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A confocal microscope focuses the laser to a diffraction-limited spot and places a pinhole in the detection path at a position conjugate to that focus; fluorescence from the focal plane passes through the pinhole centre, while light from out-of-focus planes spreads into a large patch at the pinhole and is mostly blocked. The system point-spread function is the product of the illumination and detection functions, so lateral resolution is slightly better than widefield and the axial signal decays quickly with defocus, producing an optical section. Pinhole diameter is quoted in Airy units, 1 AU being the diameter of the first dark ring of the Airy disc. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Confocal pinhole and Airy disc”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：1 AU = 1.22·λ_em/NA：λ_em = 520 nm、NA = 1.4 時為 0.453 µm（樣品面），在 63× 中間像面上為 28.6 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 1 AU = 1.22·λ_em/NA: for λ_em = 520 nm and NA = 1.4 it is 0.453 µm in the sample plane, or 28.6 µm at a 63× intermediate image.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「針孔越小，影像在所有條件下都越清晰。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A smaller pinhole always gives a sharper image under every condition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「共軛焦針孔與艾里斑」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Confocal pinhole and Airy disc”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 點照明、點偵測與光學切片：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Point illumination, point detection and optical sectioning: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「共軛焦針孔與艾里斑」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Confocal pinhole and Airy disc” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：1 AU = 1.22·λ_em/NA：λ_em = 520 nm、NA = 1.4 時為 0.453 µm（樣品面），在 63× 中間像面上為 28.6 µm。針孔 ≥ 1 AU 時橫向半高寬 ≈ 0.51·λ_exc/NA = 0.51×0.488/1.4 ≈ 0.178 µm。軸向半高寬 ≈ √{[0.88·λ_em/(n − √(n² − NA²))]² + [√2·n·PH/NA]²}，n = 1.518、PH = 1 AU 時 ≈ √(0.491² + 0.695²) ≈ 0.85 µm，PH = 2 AU 時 ≈ 1.47 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 1 AU = 1.22·λ_em/NA: for λ_em = 520 nm and NA = 1.4 it is 0.453 µm in the sample plane, or 28.6 µm at a 63× intermediate image. For a pinhole ≥ 1 AU the lateral FWHM ≈ 0.51·λ_exc/NA = 0.51×0.488/1.4 ≈ 0.178 µm. The axial FWHM ≈ √{[0.88·λ_em/(n − √(n² − NA²))]² + [√2·n·PH/NA]²}; with n = 1.518 and PH = 1 AU it is ≈ √(0.491² + 0.695²) ≈ 0.85 µm, and ≈ 1.47 µm at 2 AU. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以次解析度螢光珠（直徑 100 nm）取 z 疊層，沿 x 與 z 擬合高斯取得半高寬，與上述公式在 0.5、1、2 AU 三個針孔設定下的預測比較；同時記錄各設定的峰值訊號，確認切片厚度與訊號隨針孔的變化趨勢一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Acquire z-stacks of sub-resolution fluorescent beads (100 nm) and fit Gaussians along x and z to obtain FWHM values, comparing them with the predictions above at pinhole settings of 0.5, 1 and 2 AU; record the peak signal at each setting as well to confirm that section thickness and signal both follow the pinhole trend.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: 1 AU = 1.22·λ_em/NA: for λ_em = 520 nm and NA = 1.4 it is 0.453 µm in the sample plane, or 28.6 µm at a 63× intermediate image. For a pinhole ≥ 1 AU the lateral FWHM ≈ 0.51·λ_exc/NA = 0.51×0.488/1.4 ≈ 0.178 µm. The axial FWHM ≈ √{[0.88·λ_em/(n − √(n² − NA²))]² + [√2·n·PH/NA]²}; with n = 1.518 and PH = 1 AU it is ≈ √(0.491² + 0.695²) ≈ 0.85 µm, and ≈ 1.47 µm at 2 AU.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「點照明、點偵測與光學切片」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Point illumination, point detection and optical sectioning", which statement holds?

optionsEn: Photon-counting mode is linear at any count rate.
The focus moves inside the sample by exactly the stage displacement.
1 AU = 1.22·λ_em/NA: for λ_em = 520 nm and NA = 1.4 it is 0.453 µm in the sample plane, or 28.6 µm at a 63× intermediate image.

quiz.explanationEn: 1 AU = 1.22·λ_em/NA: for λ_em = 520 nm and NA = 1.4 it is 0.453 µm in the sample plane, or 28.6 µm at a 63× intermediate image. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 點照明、點偵測與光學切片：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Point illumination, point detection and optical sectioning: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「共軛焦針孔與艾里斑」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Confocal pinhole and Airy disc” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以次解析度螢光珠（直徑 100 nm）取 z 疊層，沿 x 與 z 擬合高斯取得半高寬，與上述公式在 0.5、1、2 AU 三個針孔設定下的預測比較；同時記錄各設定的峰值訊號，確認切片厚度與訊號隨針孔的變化趨勢一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Acquire z-stacks of sub-resolution fluorescent beads (100 nm) and fit Gaussians along x and z to obtain FWHM values, comparing them with the predictions above at pinhole settings of 0.5, 1 and 2 AU; record the peak signal at each setting as well to confirm that section thickness and signal both follow the pinhole trend. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：針孔開到 3 AU 以上追求亮度，離焦背景大量進入偵測器，切片厚度增加到數微米，厚樣品的影像退化成接近寬場的模糊疊加。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Opening the pinhole beyond 3 AU for brightness lets a large out-of-focus background reach the detector, section thickness grows to several micrometres, and images of thick samples degrade toward a widefield-like blur.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以次解析度螢光珠（直徑 100 nm）取 z 疊層，沿 x 與 z 擬合高斯取得半高寬，與上述公式在 0.5、1、2 AU 三個針孔設定下的預測比較；同時記錄各設定的峰值訊號，確認切片厚度與訊號隨針孔的變化趨勢一致。
knowledge.textEn: Acquire z-stacks of sub-resolution fluorescent beads (100 nm) and fit Gaussians along x and z to obtain FWHM values, comparing them with the predictions above at pinhole settings of 0.5, 1 and 2 AU; record the peak signal at each setting as well to confirm that section thickness and signal both follow the pinhole trend.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「點照明、點偵測與光學切片」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Point illumination, point detection and optical sectioning"?
options: 以次解析度螢光珠（直徑 100 nm）取 z 疊層，沿 x 與 z 擬合高斯取得半高寬，與上述公式在 0.5、1、2 AU 三個針孔設定下的預測比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。

Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A confocal illuminates only the focal plane, so out-of-focus sample is never bleached.

quiz.explanationEn: Acquire z-stacks of sub-resolution fluorescent beads (100 nm) and fit Gaussians along x and z to obtain FWHM values, comparing them with the predictions above at pinhole settings of 0.5, 1 and 2 AU; record the peak signal at each setting as well to confirm that section thickness and signal both follow the pinhole trend. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 點照明、點偵測與光學切片：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Point illumination, point detection and optical sectioning: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「共軛焦針孔與艾里斑」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Confocal pinhole and Airy disc” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 針孔開到 3 AU 以上追求亮度，離焦背景大量進入偵測器，切片厚度增加到數微米，厚樣品的影像退化成接近寬場的模糊疊加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.instruction: 螢光分子吸收激發光子後在奈秒內放出較長波長的光子，激發與發射的波長差（Stokes 位移）讓二向色鏡與發射濾鏡能把激發光擋掉。每個分子的發射速率受吸收截面、激發強度與激發態壽命限制，接近飽和強度時再加雷射功率只會加速光漂白。共軛焦的像素停留時間只有微秒，收集立體角、光學穿透率與偵測器量子效率又把到達偵測器的光子再砍一個數量級，因此每像素常只有數十個光子，散粒雜訊主導影像品質。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「螢光激發與光子計數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A fluorophore absorbs an excitation photon and within nanoseconds emits a longer-wavelength photon; the excitation-emission wavelength gap (Stokes shift) lets a dichroic and an emission filter block the excitation light. Confocal pixel dwell times are microseconds, and collection solid angle, optical transmission and detector quantum efficiency cut the photons reaching the detector by another order of magnitude, so a pixel often holds only tens of photons and shot noise governs image quality. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fluorescence excitation and photon count”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：吸收截面 σ = 3.82×10⁻²¹·ε cm²，ε = 80,000 M⁻¹cm⁻¹ 時 σ ≈ 3.1×10⁻¹⁶ cm²；壽命 3 ns 的飽和強度 I_sat = hν/(σ·τ) ≈ 4.07×10⁻¹⁹/(3.1×10⁻¹⁶×3×10⁻⁹) ≈ 4.4×10⁵ W/cm²。10 µW 聚焦到半徑 0.2 µm 的強度約 8×10³ W/cm²，為 I_sat 的 1.8%，每分子發射率 ≈ 0.8·σ·I/hν ≈ 4.8×10⁶ 光子/s，2 µs 停留約 9.6 個；收集效率 0.307×0.5×0.4 ≈ 6% 給 0.6 個偵測光子，100 個分子得 60 個光子，SNR ≈ 7.7。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The absorption cross-section is σ = 3.82×10⁻²¹·ε cm², so ε = 80,000 M⁻¹cm⁻¹ gives σ ≈ 3.1×10⁻¹⁶ cm²; with a 3 ns lifetime the saturation intensity I_sat = hν/(σ·τ) ≈ 4.07×10⁻¹⁹/(3.1×10⁻¹⁶×3×10⁻⁹) ≈ 4.4×10⁵ W/cm². Focusing 10 µW into a 0.2 µm radius gives about 8×10³ W/cm², 1.8% of I_sat, an emission rate per molecule ≈ 0.8·σ·I/hν ≈ 4.8×10⁶ photons/s, about 9.6 in a 2 µs dwell; a collection efficiency of 0.307×0.5×0.4 ≈ 6% leaves 0.6 detected photons, so 100 molecules give 60 photons and SNR ≈ 7.7. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在物鏡後用功率計量各雷射線的實際功率，用已知濃度的螢光素溶液與光子計數模式量每像素計數，對照上述預算；再做功率系列（1、2、4、8 倍）確認訊號在飽和前線性，並記錄漂白半衰期隨功率的變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the actual power of each laser line after the objective with a power meter, count photons per pixel in photon-counting mode on a fluorescein solution of known concentration and compare with the budget above; then run a power series (1, 2, 4, 8 times) to confirm linearity below saturation and record how the bleaching half-life changes with power.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 掃描器、物鏡與視場取樣：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Scanners, objective and field sampling: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「振鏡掃描器與掃描透鏡」如何決定共軛焦顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Galvanometer scanners and scan lens” determines the key performance of “Confocal microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 一對振鏡在物鏡後焦面的共軛位置偏轉光束，掃描透鏡與管鏡把角度轉成樣品面上的位置；振鏡在每條掃描線末端需要減速與回程，所以有效停留時間小於幀時間除以像素數。共振掃描器以固定頻率正弦掃描，速度快但每像素的停留時間只有數十奈秒，光子數大幅減少。物鏡的焦距（管鏡焦距除以放大率）與掃描半角決定最大視場，像素尺寸則由視場除以像素數決定，要達到奈奎斯特條件必須小於橫向半高寬的一半。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「振鏡掃描器與掃描透鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A galvanometer pair deflects the beam at a plane conjugate to the objective back focal plane, and the scan lens and tube lens convert angle into position on the sample; the mirrors must decelerate and fly back at each line end, so the effective dwell is less than frame time divided by pixel count. A resonant scanner oscillates sinusoidally at a fixed frequency, fast but with only tens of nanoseconds per pixel and far fewer photons. The objective focal length (tube-lens focal length over magnification) and scan half-angle set the maximum field, pixel size is field over pixel count, and Nyquist sampling requires it to be below half the lateral FWHM. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Galvanometer scanners and scan lens”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：63× 物鏡配 200 mm 管鏡，f_obj = 3.17 mm；瞳孔處掃描半角 ±2.5° 給視場 2×3.17×tan2.5° ≈ 277 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 63× objective with a 200 mm tube lens has f_obj = 3.17 mm; a ±2.5° scan half-angle at the pupil gives a field of 2×3.17×tan2.5° ≈ 277 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「像素數越多，影像解析度就越高，與變焦無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 掃描器、物鏡與視場取樣：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scanners, objective and field sampling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「振鏡掃描器與掃描透鏡」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Galvanometer scanners and scan lens” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：63× 物鏡配 200 mm 管鏡，f_obj = 3.17 mm；瞳孔處掃描半角 ±2.5° 給視場 2×3.17×tan2.5° ≈ 277 µm。橫向半高寬 0.178 µm 的奈奎斯特像素 ≤ 0.089 µm，277 µm 需 3100 像素，1024 像素時像素 0.27 µm 欠取樣 3 倍，故需 3× 變焦到 92 µm 視場。振鏡 1 幀/s、512×512、70% 占空比時停留 ≈ 2.7 µs；8 kHz 共振掃描每行 62.5 µs，512 像素平均僅約 85 ns。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 63× objective with a 200 mm tube lens has f_obj = 3.17 mm; a ±2.5° scan half-angle at the pupil gives a field of 2×3.17×tan2.5° ≈ 277 µm. Nyquist sampling of a 0.178 µm lateral FWHM needs pixels ≤ 0.089 µm, i.e. 3100 pixels across 277 µm; at 1024 pixels the 0.27 µm pixel undersamples by 3, so a 3× zoom to a 92 µm field is needed. A galvanometer at 1 frame/s, 512×512 and 70% duty gives a dwell ≈ 2.7 µs; an 8 kHz resonant scanner spends 62.5 µs per line, only about 85 ns per pixel on average over 512 pixels. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用載物台測微尺或 10 µm 週期的格線標板量各變焦下的像素尺寸與視場，檢查 x 與 y 比例是否一致、邊緣是否有正弦失真；以示波器量像素時脈與振鏡位置回授，確認停留時間與占空比符合設定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure pixel size and field at several zoom settings with a stage micrometer or a 10 µm grid target, checking that x and y scales agree and that the edges show no sinusoidal distortion; probe the pixel clock and galvanometer position feedback with an oscilloscope to confirm dwell time and duty cycle match the settings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.instruction: 針孔是可變直徑的機械光闌，必須精確對準到偵測光路的共軛焦點，橫向偏差超過十分之一艾里單位就會損失訊號並使切片不對稱。偵測器從多鹼光電倍增管進展到 GaAsP 光陰極與混合式偵測器，量子效率從約 20% 提升到 40% 以上；光子計數模式消除增益雜訊，但每個脈衝後有死時間，計數率高時會漏計，需要修正或降低功率。光譜偵測以稜鏡或光柵把發射光分散到多陽極偵測器上，容許多染料的線性拆分。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「GaAsP 偵測器與針孔機構」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 點擴散函數、比例尺與色差校正：原理與系統邊界

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fluorescent-bead PSF and grid target” determines the key performance of “Confocal microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 校正分三個層次：橫向比例尺用已知週期的格線標板；三維點擴散函數用次解析度螢光珠，量半高寬並與理論比較以判斷物鏡、針孔與對準狀態；多通道配準用多色螢光珠量各波長之間的橫向與軸向偏移。物鏡的軸向色差在 488 與 640 nm 之間常有一到數百奈米，若不校正，雙色共定位會出現假陽性或假陰性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「螢光珠 PSF 與格線標板」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：100 nm 珠在 63×/1.4、1 AU 下量到橫向半高寬 0.21 µm、軸向 0.98 µm，對理論 0.178 與 0.85 µm 的比值為 1.18 與 1.15，均在 1.2 的允收線內。10 µm 格線量到 10.05 µm 表示比例尺偏 0.5%，在 277 µm 視場上累積 1.4 µm 誤差；488 與 640 nm 通道軸向偏移量到 150 nm，需以校正檔平移後再做共定位分析。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 100 nm bead at 63×/1.4 and 1 AU measures 0.21 µm laterally and 0.98 µm axially, ratios of 1.18 and 1.15 to the theoretical 0.178 and 0.85 µm, both inside the 1.2 acceptance line. steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For each objective and laser set acquire one bead z-stack and record the three-axis FWHM values and channel offsets; re-measure the scale monthly with the grid target and inspect scanner calibration when the trend drifts beyond 0.3%; store calibration files with date and conditions in the system.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.title: 折射率失配、球差與軸向誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Index mismatch, spherical aberration and the axial error budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「折射率失配與軸向比例」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Refractive-index mismatch and axial scaling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：近軸焦點位移比 ≈ n_sample/n_imm = 1.33/1.518 = 0.876：載物台移動 10 µm 時焦點只深入 8.76 µm，厚 10 µm 的結構在影像中顯示為 11.4 µm，未修正即為 14% 的系統誤差。以 0.43 µm 的 z 步進，量化誤差約 ±0.12 µm；在水中 30 µm 深處球差使軸向半高寬由 0.85 µm 展寬到約 1.7 µm，是淺層的兩倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The paraxial focal-shift ratio ≈ n_sample/n_imm = 1.33/1.518 = 0.876: a 10 µm stage move takes the focus only 8.76 µm deeper, so a 10 µm thick structure appears 11.4 µm in the image, a 14% systematic error if uncorrected. With a 0.43 µm z-step the quantization error is about ±0.12 µm; at 30 µm into water, spherical aberration broadens the axial FWHM from 0.85 µm to roughly 1.7 µm, twice the shallow value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把螢光珠固定在水性凝膠中不同深度，量各深度的軸向半高寬與峰值，畫出隨深度的退化曲線；用已知厚度的夾層樣品比較影像厚度與真實厚度，得出實際比例因子並與 0.876 比較，決定是否改用水鏡或矽油鏡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fix fluorescent beads at several depths in an aqueous gel, measure axial FWHM and peak at each depth and plot the degradation curve; compare the imaged thickness of a spacer sample of known thickness with its true value to obtain the actual scale factor, compare with 0.876, and decide whether a water or silicone-oil objective is required.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 折射率失配、球差與軸向誤差預算：量測與驗證

steps.instruction: 整合階段要把雷射合併與 AOTF 功率控制、掃描時序、針孔、偵測器與 z 驅動統一在一個擷取流程裡，並依奈奎斯特條件決定 x、y、z 取樣。共軛焦在擷取每一層時，整個雙錐照明體積都被曝光，所以厚樣品的每個體素會被照射到次數等於層數，劑量管理必須把層數、通道數與幀平均一起算進去；時序影像還要在訊號雜訊比與漂白之間決定幀間隔。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Z 疊層時序與雷射劑量表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 系統整合、取樣策略與劑量管理：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System integration, sampling strategy and dose management: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Z 疊層時序與雷射劑量表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Z-stack timing and laser-dose table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：軸向半高寬 0.85 µm 的奈奎斯特 z 步進 ≤ 0.43 µm，20 µm 厚樣品需 47 層。1024×1024、停留 2 µs 加回程約 2.5 s/幀，單通道疊層約 2 分鐘，三通道依序擷取約 6 分鐘；每個體素被照射 47 次，若線平均 2 次則劑量加倍而 SNR 只升 √2 ≈ 1.41 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Nyquist z-step for a 0.85 µm axial FWHM is ≤ 0.43 µm, so a 20 µm thick sample needs 47 slices. At 1024×1024 with 2 µs dwell plus fly-back, about 2.5 s per frame, a single-channel stack takes about 2 minutes and three sequential channels about 6 minutes; each voxel is irradiated 47 times, and line averaging by 2 doubles the dose while raising SNR only by √2 ≈ 1.41. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以均勻螢光片在設定的雷射功率下連續擷取並擬合漂白曲線，得出每幀的衰減率；把擷取計畫（層數、通道、平均次數）代入估算整個實驗的總衰減，並與實際樣品的首尾幀訊號比較以驗證劑量模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On a uniform fluorescent slide at the planned laser power acquire continuously and fit the bleaching curve to obtain the per-frame decay; insert the acquisition plan (slices, channels, averages) to estimate total decay across the experiment and compare with first-to-last frame signal on the real sample to validate the dose model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Z-stack timing and laser-dose table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以均勻螢光片在設定的雷射功率下連續擷取並擬合漂白曲線，得出每幀的衰減率；把擷取計畫（層數、通道、平均次數）代入估算整個實驗的總衰減，並與實際樣品的首尾幀訊號比較以驗證劑量模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 驗收測試矩陣與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Acceptance test matrix and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「驗收矩陣與校正檔」如何決定共軛焦顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acceptance matrix and calibration files” determines the key performance of “Confocal microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 驗收以測試矩陣進行：每個物鏡的三維點擴散函數、視場照度均勻性、通道配準、每條雷射線在樣品面的功率與穩定度、偵測器線性與死時間、載物台與 z 驅動重複性。每項設定允收門檻並附量測方法，結果與校正檔、韌體與軟體版本一起歸檔；交接文件還需記載針孔對準基準、AOTF 功率對照表與已知限制（例如深層水性樣品需水鏡），使後續使用者能判斷系統狀態是否仍在驗收範圍內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收矩陣與校正檔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance follows a test matrix: three-dimensional point-spread function per objective, field illumination uniformity, channel registration, power and stability of each laser line at the sample plane, detector linearity and dead time, and stage and z-drive repeatability.
